exposure.needed: whether ingested log lines exceed 256KB and whether the max line size limit is explicitly configured

original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 now enforces a max log line size of 256KB by default; it can be disabled or raised.

decision.reason: [ev-af3121d71703] says only that Loki 3.0 now enforces a 256KB max line size by default, and that operators can disable or raise it. An environment is affected only if it keeps the default and actually ingests lines over 256KB. Line size at ingestion is runtime data that no static input shows. The excerpt also doesn't name the config key, so no values-key predicate can be written from the evidence. The proposed undecidable(runtime-behavior-gap) condition names both inputs that are needed. P2's alternative (edge-from-version <3.0.0) would flag every upgrading environment, which is too broad.
